profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
SUMMARY: 
MUMPS/Cache programmer with over 30 years of experience designing solutions for healthcare, financial, and educational applications. 

Historically: MUMPS Programmer/Analyst with extensive experience on multiple platforms. Self motivated troubleshooter, with excellent analytical, technical and communications skills. Strong medical and financial applications background achieved developing and supporting a wide variety of products. Focused on increased productivity without increased spending. Brings together resources from various locations to close the mileage gap. Remote and satellite office work-style specialist. Results driven and profit oriented.

Specialties: MUMPS/Cache, VAX, VMS, GTM, DSM, Data security, adobe photoshop,  DCL, crystal reports,  customer relations,    Dreamweaver,  filenet,  html,  imaging,  microsoft excel,  microsoft windows,  microsoft word,  ms dos, performance management,  programming,  scripting,  SQL,  supervisory skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer/Consultant
positions.description: Data extraction, and reporting specialist. VMS, Linux, MUMPS/Cache

positions.title: Sr.  MUMPS Developer
positions.description: Working on Veterans Administration (VA) T4NG tasks. Using MUMPS, Cache, Fileman, VistA Integration Adapter (VIA), SoapUI, XML.

positions.title: VistA Maintenance MUMPS Developer
positions.description: I supported the VA VistA Health Information System using MUMPS & FileMan. My package responsibilities have included; Patient Care Encounter (PCE), Patient Merge, Registration, Scheduling, Enrollment, Radiology, & Integrated Billing. I started with HP first as a contractor through PruTech Solutions and then worked directly for HP.

positions.title: MUMPS Developer
positions.description: Working with HP on VA VistA system maintenance. MUMPS, Cache, VistA (PX(PCE),SD,XT(XDR)), Fileman

positions.title: Contract Programmer
positions.description:
Created interfaces, data extracts, reports, and utilities to help with day to day operations and prepare for a system upgrade.
(GTM, VMS, EDT editor)

positions.title: Contract Programmer
positions.description: Create financial reports and utilities for system resource monitoring. (MUMPS/Cache, VMS, IDX/GE Centricity)

positions.title: Vice President Data Processing
positions.description:
Managed and supported the Sungard Trustware-11 system. Analyzed the feasibility of system enhancements, implemented modifications, and coordinated resources for support of systems used in daily operation. Designed and supported interfaces to automate sharing of data with other systems.  (Alphaserver 4100, VMS, DCL, GTM, SQL, Crystal Reports Designer)
Developed daily process notifying loan officers of devalued collateral which might compromise loan security. This prevented margin shortages in the millions of dollars.
Delivered scripts to automate data entry and saved significant FTE resource time.
Provided in-depth remote support to locations throughout the state of Florida.
Automated reports of percentages lost on assets, and market sector information to increase productivity in the investments department.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Led the team in mapping of globals using KB_SQL, and writing filers for the MUMPS/ORACLE Data Interface. Supported legacy system during system re-write. (GTM, VAX/VMS, CyberM)
Played key role in the analysis of existing system functionality and documentation of globals to assist the ORACLE team in the rewrite of the system. 
Administered highly successful conversion from MUMPS to ORACLE.

positions.title: Custom Project Manager
positions.description:
Reviewed all requests for custom programming. Analyzed feasibility, time required to accomplish, resources needed, and target date for completion. (RS6000 - AIX Mumps)
Delivered solutions, code, quality testing, and billing for projects.
Supervised customer contact in reference for all of the requests and ensured timely delivery.

positions.title: Manager of Database Maintenance
positions.description:
Assumed management responsibilities, supervising seven programmers. (VAX/VMS MUMPS)
Coordinated all requests for modifications to operational applications including registration, candidate inquiries, test administration, transcripts, data services, and FileNet imaging.

positions.title: Senior Analyst/Programmer
positions.description:
Supported the LIST system (MUMPS) on a VAX. LIST controls the manipulation of candidate information. 
Evaluated and researched problems, implemented solutions and designed enhancements.

positions.title: Systems Analyst/Programmer
positions.description:
Supported the Radiology patient care system. Used DCL, VMS utilities, and DECrad, a large DSM application, written in DEC's code generating tool, DASL. 
Key role in development of new functionality, the analysis and implementation of system modifications that improved system usability, and performance management.

company.name: Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania

positions.title: Installations Programmer
positions.description:
Adapted standard applications to the custom specs of health care facilities. 
Provided onsite installations and supported software until stable.
